warning_texts: Gate discrepancy: gate_release_document wording_matches_claims passed report.md although line 23 claims near-certainty about the true channel value; the rule only examined the word 'significant' beside the two test claims, so interval wording is unchecked by any machine rule.

Gate discrepancy: gate_release_document caveats_rendered passed every AOV card and line, correctly against the register, but the register itself lacks the net-of-refunds and delivered-only caveats the dataset requires for AOV, and check_plan caveats_declared does not require them for CLM-AOV-*.

release_surface_contract.json declares no reconciliations, no card_caveat_requirements and no visual_evidence, so per-card population, period, n and level are checked by no machine rule; everything in that area rests on this audit alone.

Both registered tests display p as 0.0000 (four digits from a register value of 0.0000000000); the recomputed two-proportion p is about 2.9e-157, and a reader may take 0.0000 as p equal to zero, so '< 0.0001' would read more honestly.

src/release/build_release.py comparison() labels a test significant when p is below the plan's unadjusted alpha 0.05, while it prints 'bonferroni correction' beside it; the Bonferroni threshold for two hypotheses is 0.025. Both p values are far below either, so the page is right today, but the rule
The dashboard test cards show p, effect and statistic without hypothesis id, method, alpha or correction; only the direction caveat accompanies them.
The completion caveat 'one quarter of orders in this channel' is the only hint on the page that the denominator is every order in the channel; it does not name cancelled and pending orders.
